list.title: Sarah Heitz
list.description: If you skipped the site tour and landed straight here in the hidden section below the visualization: Congratulations and welcome! I'm Sarah, a graphic designer and illustrator, and according to this timeline I've been doing nothing else my entire professional life (wow!).
list.Achievment_1: As a part of Superdot I was able to teach Information Design at HSLU Lucerne.
list.Achievment_2: I am a member of the Comic Crew BS / BL
list.Achievment_3: My Concept art is featured in the Documentary Endlich Tacheles.
